# Shared Pollinations UI

MIDI Journey 2 uses the published `@pollinations/ui@0.1.0-alpha.11`, pinned exactly
in package.json and package-lock.json with npm integrity verification. This version
provides flat surfaces, the shared color-mode control and account menu. Markdown
is imported from the package’s dedicated `/markdown` entry point.

`POLLINATIONS-LICENSE` preserves the upstream MIT attribution. Release packaging
collects installed dependency licenses, including the shared UI font licenses.
